component.name: NotCourierSans
component.summary: NotCourier Sans is a re-interpretation of Nimbus Mono

description.p:
This is a new release of the NotCourier-sans, with its bold.
NotCourier-sans is a re-interpretation of Nimbus Mono and was designed in Wroclaw at the occasion of Linux Graphics Meeting (LGM 2008).For more detailed information: ospublish.constantvzw.org.
